title: Mercury

history.summary:
## What I did
- Built full-page alpine banking website for Mercury adhering strictly to the Mercury Alpine Banking design system.
- Designed 7 complete sections: Header, Hero, Features, Pricing, Testimonials, Contact, and Footer.
- Implemented interactive states: split-pill email capture form, 3-category capability filter tabs, interactive APY yield calculator with reserve slider, founder quote carousel, and expandable wire cutoff disclosure drawer.
- Zero drop shadows, flat Onyx (#171721) canvas with Graphite (#1e1e2a) cards and single Cobalt (#5266eb) primary action.

## Status
- ✅ All 7 sections fully synthesized and compiled.
- ✅ Vite production build clean with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
history.content: Synthesized site with 15 files across 7 sections.
